message:
The other day, we had a little scare when the weather reports hinted at a storm coming our way. My husband and I decided to take a few minutes to check our supplies, and wouldn't you know it, we found an extra stash of batteries tucked away in the back of the pantry. 

Not exactly a treasure trove, but in that moment, it felt like a small win. We could charge our flashlights and keep the kids entertained if the power went out. It’s funny how little things can make a big difference in a pinch.

Have you had any little preparedness victories lately? I’d love to hear your tips!
